title: (Senior) Technical Project Manager Germany
description: <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">About Parloa</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">About the role:</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">As <strong>(Senior) Technical Project Manager</strong>, you will own the end-to-end delivery of high complexity Agentic AI deployments for enterprise customers, running your pod (TPM, Forward Deployed Engineer, Agent Architect) as a single accountable delivery unit from scoping through go-live and hypercare.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">This is your opportunity to sit at the center of how global enterprise brands adopt Agentic AI, translating technical complexity into business outcomes for executive stakeholders at companies like Booking.com, SAP, and Allianz.</p> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Areas of ownership:</h3> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Own scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality for assigned Agentic AI customer projects, selecting the right delivery methodology (Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid) for each customer context.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Customer &amp; Stakeholder Management:</strong> Act as the primary delivery contact for customer sponsors, IT, and business stakeholders, running governance calls, steering committees, UAT readouts, and go-live reviews.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Cross-Functional &amp; Pod Coordination:</strong> Align Forward Deployed Engineers on integration readiness and Agent Architects on discovery and conversational design, while coordinating with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Support across the customer journey.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Methodology &amp; Process Discipline:</strong> Facilitate sprints and retros or lead stage-gate reviews depending on methodology, and enforce documentation standards across charters, design docs, runbooks, and handovers.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Metrics &amp; Reporting:</strong> Track deployment KPIs such as time to first agent in UAT and milestone on-time rate, and report delivery status and risk posture to internal and external stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Who you are:</h3> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">2+ years of experience in technical program management, program management, or delivery management for SaaS or enterprise software</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Hands-on experience delivering solutions in Contact Center/CCaaS, UCaaS, conversational AI, IVA/IVR, or related CX platforms</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum, Hybrid, and Waterfall methodologies, with judgment on when to apply each</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects with global, distributed teams</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Fluent in English and German</li> </ul> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Our recruiting process:</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview → Bar Raiser</p> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Why Parloa?</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. raw.description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.

  2. Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer)

Why us?

What you can expect

title: Werkstudent*in Public Sector - KI Strategie & Innovation
description: Unsere Mission dida ist eine der führenden Machine Learning Agenturen mit Aufträgen und Projekten in der Wissenschaft, der Industrie und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Unser Team , das überwiegend aus Machine Learning Scientists besteht, trägt zu neuen Erkenntnissen und Innovationen im Bereich Künstlicher Intelligenz bei. Wir wollen zu einer bewussten Entwicklung und Integration von Machine Learning in allen Gesellschaftsbereichen beitragen. Werde Teil unseres Public Sector Teams und unterstütze uns dabei, öffentliche KI-Digitalprojekte bei Ministerien, Krankenkassen oder Ämtern auf EU, Bundes- und Landesebene zu gewinnen und damit die Verwaltung der Zukunft mitzugestalten. Du wirst: Teil unseres Public-Sector Teams sein und vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, um ein junges und erfolgreiches Geschäftsfeld mit aufzubauen. Neue Geschäftsfelder erkunden, indem du Innovationspotenziale an der Schnittstelle zwischen KI und dem öffentlichen Sektor (EU, Bund und Länder) identifizierst. Im Kundenkontakt zu öffentlichen Bedarfsträgern, durch deine Vorbereitung von und Teilnahme an Terminen, unterstützen. Und der technischste Teil (kein Muss): Bei der Gestaltung von KI-Projektkonzepten im Zusammenspiel mit unseren Machine Learning Scientists mitwirken. Dein Profil Du studierst in einem wirtschaftlichen oder technischen Studiengang und interessierst dich für Technik und ihre Anwendung. Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast Lust darauf, Erfahrungen am Kunden zu machen: Chancen erkennen, auf Menschen zugehen, Angebote mitentwickeln. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und besitzt eine hohe Auffassungsgabe. Kein Muss, aber ein Plus: Du hast erstes Verständnis für die Interessen wichtiger Stakeholder in der öffentlichen Verwaltung gesammelt, sei es aus Praktika, aus Werkstudierendenerfahrungen oder aus deinem Studium. Kein Muss, aber ein Plus: du hast bereits unternehmerische Initiative gezeigt oder erste Berührungspunkte mit der Geschäftsentwicklung gehabt. Wenn du in Berlin wohnst ist das ein Plus, du studierst mind. noch 3 Semester und möchtest mindestens 16 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten. Dein Deutsch ist mindestens auf C1-Niveau; gleichzeitig kannst du dich mit Kolleg*innen im Unternehmen auf Englisch verständigen. Ohne mindestens C1 können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen. Warum du dich für uns entscheiden solltest? Setze deine Motivation und dein Engagement in einer Umgebung ein, in der diese wertgeschätzt werden. Du kannst wertvolle Erfahrung im engen Zusammenspiel mit der Unternehmens- und Geschäftsfeldleitung erwarten. Werde Teil eines hochqualifizierten Unternehmens, das innovative Lösungen für Industrie, Wissenschaft und den öffentlichen Sektor konzipiert und umsetzt. Übernimm abwechslungsreiche, verantwortungsvolle und strategische Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle zwischen Wirtschaft und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Konzeptioniere spannende Projekte, wie das Identifizieren von illegalen Minen im Regenwald, das Erkennen von Objekten auf Schienen für die Deutsche Bahn , die Entwicklung einer semantischen Suche für das Wirtschaftsserviceportal des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen, das den Bürgern den Zugang zu Dienstleistungen der öffentlichen Verwaltung ermöglicht, oder die KI-gestützte KI-Digitalisierung von Geschäftsvorgängen bei einer großen gesetzlichen Krankenkasse. Genieße flexible, hybride Arbeitszeiten mit der Möglichkeit Remote oder in unserem Büro in Berlin Kreuzberg (U Kottbusser Tor) zu arbeiten. raw.description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.

Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was.


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management
  • Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed
  • Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams
  • Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such
  • Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream
  • Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops
  • Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge

    • Your Profile ✨
  • Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations
  • A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers
  • Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you
  • Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly
  • Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill
  • A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero
  • Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors

    • Nice to have
  • German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German
  • Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing
  • Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel)

    • Your Benefits 🪴
  • Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
  • Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation
  • Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days
  • Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more
  • Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences
  • Discounted access to Wellpass for comprehensive wellbeing support - enjoy fitness, wellness, and mindfulness options to help you stay balanced and energized

raw.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Your new team: As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process. What awaits you: You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts. You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers. You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection. You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues. You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process. You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development. You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working. Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients. What you can expect: At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective. You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups. You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting. What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team. What you bring along: You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups. Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself We look forward to meeting you!   • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.

About the Position

As Procurement Director, you will build one of HOLY's most important competitive advantages: a world-class supplier ecosystem that enables us to scale faster, improve margins and consistently deliver outstanding products to our customers.

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing
  • Develop category strategies that improve competitiveness, resilience and long-term scalability
  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering
  • Identify new sourcing opportunities, technologies and supplier capabilities to strengthen HOLY's competitive position
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans
  • Establish HOLY as a preferred customer through trust, transparency and professional supplier management
  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Strong track record of leading and developing teams 
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: A 30-minute introductory conversation with Lutza, our Talent Acquisition Lead to get to know each other and discuss your experience, motivation and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep-dive discussion with Markus, our COO about your experience, leadership style and how you approach complex business challenges.
  3. Case Study: You will receive a business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking, analytical approach and ability to solve real HOLY challenges.
  4. Advanced Discussion in our office, the HOLY Temple: Present and discuss your case with key stakeholders while getting to know our team and our way of working.
  5. Founder Interview: A final conversation with Fredi, one of HOLY's founders to ensure a strong mutual fit.
  6. Offer & Decision: If everything aligns, we will make you an offer and hopefully welcome you to the HOLY team.
Typically, this process takes around 2–3 weeks.

raw.description:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Working Student to support the Legal team at AMBOSS!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

You will:

  • Review smaller vendor contracts: check them against our standard criteria, flag anything that needs a closer look from our Legal Counsels, and take the routine cases through to approval yourself

  • Bring structure to our contract landscape: classify vendors into our vendor categories, build a clean filing logic, and make sure every agreement ends up where it belongs instead of in someone's inbox

  • Support our data protection work in close collaboration with our Legal Counsel Privacy & IT: reviewing DPAs and vendor privacy terms, keeping our records of processing activities up to date, and flagging where personal data is involved

  • Draft and manage low-level partnership agreements with student associations, from first draft to signature

  • Support the team on civil law and IP topics, from trademark and copyright questions to content usage

  • Grow into handling simple B2B cases independently over your first months with us

You bring:

  • You are enrolled in a law programme in Germany and in your 5th semester or beyond — we're open on where in Germany you study and are located

  • German at C2 level and English at C1 or above: our contracts and counterparties are largely German, our company language is English, and you'll move between both daily

  • An interest in data protection — you don't need to be a GDPR expert, but you should be the kind of person who notices when something touches personal data and asks about it

  • First exposure to or genuine interest in civil law and IP law, whether from your studies or a previous role

  • A structured, reliable way of working: the kind of person who finishes the filing, not just the interesting part of the task

  • Clear, precise writing — you'll draft and comment on contracts that other AMBOSSians rely on

You enjoy:

  • You work independently and with ambition, but in close collaboration with a team of three seniors — you don't need someone checking in on you to make progress

  • You pick things up hands-on and want to keep growing beyond the tasks you already know

  • You have good judgement about what you can decide yourself and what needs the owner of a senior team member and you'd rather ask once too often than once too little

  • You're curious about how legal work connects to the commercial side of a business, and you want to see contracts in their real context rather than only in a seminar

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

🌴 Rest & Time Off (paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone— regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

title: Customer Success Manager (d/w/m)
description: Über uns und unsere Mission: Jahr für Jahr verzichten Millionen von Menschen auf die ihnen zustehende Steuerrückerstattung – viele davon aus Angst vor der Steuererklärung. Taxfix ändert das. Wir möchten es allen ermöglichen, das Thema Steuern und Finanzen in die eigenen Hände zu nehmen. Mit unserer intuitiven App können alle – unabhängig von Bildungsgrad und Hintergrundwissen – die Steuererklärung unkompliziert einreichen. Das Taxfix-Team ist eine Gruppe Problemlöser:innen, die Ideen offen aussprechen und gemeinsam besprechen. Mit Büros in Berlin und Madrid und mehr als 350 Teammitglieder:innen aus über 65 Nationen sind wir reich an vielfältigen Stimmen und Ideen. In sieben Jahren konnten wir mehr als 300 Millionen Euro an Finanzierungsmitteln erhalten und gleichzeitig vielen Menschen dabei helfen, mehr als 3 Milliarden Euro an Steuererstattungen vom Finanzamt zurückzuholen. Was Du bei uns machst: Als Customer Success Manager im Customer Success Team hast Du die Freiheit, von zu Hause oder aus unserem modernen Büro zu arbeiten. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen bei Fragen rund um Taxfix per Chat und E-Mail kompetent, empathisch und verlässlich unterstützt werden. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team sowie Kolleg:innen aus Operations, Product und weiteren relevanten Bereichen löst Du auch komplexere Anliegen und bringst Kundenfeedback ein, um unsere Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Deine Aufgaben: Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei der Nutzung der Taxfix-App und beantwortest ihre Anfragen per Chat und E-Mail klar, empathisch und lösungsorientiert. Du bearbeitest vielfältige Anliegen rund um die App-Nutzung, technische Funktionen, Zahlungen, steuerliche Themen und Datenschutz. Du löst komplexere oder sensible Fälle selbstständig und leitest sie bei Bedarf mit dem richtigen Kontext an die zuständigen Stellen weiter. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team, internen Operations-Teams und Steuerexpert:innen zusammen, damit unsere Kund:innen zeitnah und zuverlässig unterstützt werden. Du entwickelst Supportprozesse, Vorlagen, Makros und unsere interne Wissensbasis gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen und Verbesserungspotenziale, strukturierst Kundenfeedback und bringst daraus konkrete Impulse für Produkt und Prozesse ein. Du wirkst an teamübergreifenden Projekten und saisonalen Initiativen mit, die unser Service- und Supporterlebnis weiterentwickeln. Das bringst Du mit: Du verfügst über etwa zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, Customer Support, Customer Care oder einem vergleichbaren serviceorientierten Umfeld; Erfahrung aus Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel ist ebenfalls willkommen. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Du handelst konsequent kundenorientiert und kommunizierst auch bei Beschwerden, Eskalationen oder technischen Problemen klar, empathisch und souverän. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst Wissen proaktiv und trägst zu einer offenen, verlässlichen Zusammenarbeit bei. Du bringst eine lösungs- und prozessorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Gespür für die Qualität schriftlicher Kundenkommunikation mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit CRM- oder Ticketsystemen wie Zendesk, Intercom oder Salesforce gearbeitet; steuerliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du bist neugierig, anpassungsfähig und bereit, neue Produkte, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen zu erlernen; erste Erfahrungen mit generativer AI sind willkommen. Warum Taxfix? Eine Gelegenheit, bedeutungsvolle, auf Menschen ausgerichtete Arbeit mit einem internationalen Team leidenschaftlicher Fachleute zu verrichten. Ganzheitliches Wohlbefinden mit kostenlosen Coaching-Sitzungen für mentale Gesundheit und Yoga. Ein monatliches Budget, welches Du für eine umfangreiche Palette von Dienstleistungen verwenden kannst. Aktienoptionen für alle Mitarbeitenden – denn alle verdienen es, vom Erfolg zu profitieren! 30 jährliche Urlaubstage und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Hybrides arbeiten sowie bis zu sechs Wochen pro Jahr aus Ausland wenn gewünscht. Stimm Dich einfach mit Deinem Team ab und genieße deine Reise. Viele Möglichkeiten, als Team zu sozialisieren - virtuell und persönlich, wenn möglich. Natürlich kostenlose Steuererklärung durch die Taxfix-App – und interne Unterstützung bei allen persönlichen steuerbezogenen Fragen. Ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget zur Unterstützung Deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung sowie Beratung durch unsere internen L&D-Experten. Du hast einen vierbeinigen Freund in Deinem Leben? Wir freuen uns, Hunde bei uns im Büro willkommen zu heißen! Bei Taxfix akzeptieren wir Vielfalt nicht nur - wir feiern sie. Wir sind stolz darauf, dass wir uns für gleiche Beschäftigungschancen einsetzen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Hautfarbe, Behinderung oder Herkunft. Wir schätzen den individuellen Beitrag jeder Person. Schließe dich uns an! Hört sich gut an? Super! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Always be curious: Learn the business, customer and talent market deeply. Ask why before accepting demand, test assumptions and turn market and quality-of-hire evidence into better workforce decisions.

raw.description:
At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running.

Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more.

Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software.

WHAT THIS ROLE OFFERS

As (Senior) Enterprise Account Executive at remberg, you will proactively engage decision-makers, craft tailored strategies to win them over as customers, and guide them through the sales process—from initial contact to closing. You will be a trusted advisor to our customers, ensuring they maximize their value with remberg's solutions.

THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

  • Enterprise Sales: Take full strategic responsibility for acquiring, developing, and expanding enterprise accounts - from identifying high-value opportunities to growing them into long-term partnerships.

  • Lead engagement & conversion: Proactively approach pre-qualified decision-makers, develop strategies to win them over, and guide them from first contact to contract signing.

  • Tailored sales approach: Present customized solutions via online demos, calls, and on-site meetings, facilitating effective trials for high-potential leads.

  • Trusted advisory: Act as a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders, demonstrating remberg’s value as a best-in-class agentic maintenance software while addressing objections professionally.

  • Stakeholder management: Identify and involve all relevant stakeholders (e.g., operations, IT, leadership) to ensure a smooth and efficient sales process.

  • Pipeline & forecasting: Continuously manage and optimize your HubSpot pipeline to ensure accurate quarterly forecasting.

  • Customer insights & collaboration: Share feedback from customer interactions with Product Teams to drive solution improvements and refine our go-to-market strategy.

HOW YOU'LL GROW WITH US

  • B2B sales experience: 5+ years in B2B Enterprise SaaS sales with a proven track record of success.

  • Customer engagement & communication: Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for engaging with customers, combined with exceptional communication and negotiation abilities.

  • Problem-solving skills: Ability to remain calm in challenging situations, dive deep into problems, and develop creative solutions.

  • Proactivity & teamwork: Proactive, idea-driven, and a reliable team player who consistently delivers on commitments.

  • Growth mindset & pipeline building: Passion for continuous learning and professional development, comfortable occasionally conducting cold outreach to boost your pipeline.

  • Language skills: Fluent in German (C2) and proficient in English (C1), both written and spoken.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO THRIVE

  • 💰 Competitive compensation package: Enjoy a salary, benefits, and equity*, with annual reviews.

  • 💻 State-of-the-art tools and equipment for a modern and efficient setup.

  • 🍏 Health and wellness benefits: Access to Nilo Health, JobRad*, and your choice between a GUUD card or Wellpass / Urban Sports Club for sports and fitness.

  • 🥨 Prime office location & culture: Our office is in the heart of Munich, near the main train station, making it easily accessible for commuters and travelers. Our office is always lively, with 3 days/week in the office.

  • 🌞 Work-from-anywhere flexibility: You can work remotely for up to 3 months per year.

  • 🌴 Attractive Compensation & Benefits: In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy different company benefits and 30 vacation days*.

  • 📚 Continuous learning: Get a €1,500 development budget plus 1 day of educational leave per year.*

  • 🤝 Volunteering day: 1 paid day per year to give back to a cause you care about.

*Some perks apply to permanent full-time employees only.

ABOUT US

remberg is a fast-growing start-up based in Munich. Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from TU Munich & CDTM. We help industrial companies to keep the physical world running by simplifying maintenance with modern, agentic software. Today, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. With ~28 M € capital raised by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software (CMMS/EAM).

Du arbeitest selbstständig, proaktiv und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Du bist organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick. Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell – insbesondere im Austausch mit Influencer*innen und externen Partnern. Du bringst Kreativität mit, hast Spaß daran, neue Ideen einzubringen und bestehende Formate weiterzuentwickeln. Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Social-Media-Kennzahlen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Social Media Management, Creator Marketing oder Tools wie der Meta Business Suite oder TikTok sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Content Creation als Akteur:in vor der Kamera wäre ein nice-to-have. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung – kein Mikromanagement, sondern echtes Vertrauen in deine Fähigkeiten, hervorragende Ergebnisse zu liefern. Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, das auf Resultate fokussiert ist. Möglichkeit zu Workations im Ausland über unser WorkFlex-Tool. Monatlicher Mobilitätszuschuss von 30 €, den du für das Verkehrsmittel deiner Wahl nutzen kannst (z. B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft. Geförderte EGYM WELLPASS-Mitgliedschaft – du zahlst nur 25 € pro Monat und erhältst Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios und Sportangeboten in ganz Deutschland. Monatliche Firmenevents sowie regelmäßige Teamaktivitäten und informelle Treffen – besonders beliebt: unsere kostenlose Lunches von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro! Klingt interessant? raw.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. description: Du hast Freude daran, dass Gehaltsabrechnungen pünktlich erstellt werden und über eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe hinweg effizient, digital und rechtssicher funktionieren? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Senior Payroll / Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter (m/w/d) - Standort Recklinghausen | Hybrides Setup Als Senior Payroll / Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb unseres Payroll-Teams und verantwortest gemeinsam mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, die Entgeltabrechnung für die Arsipa Holding sowie unsere über 20 Tochtergesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem Payroll-Team stellst Du sicher, dass unsere Entgeltabrechnung für über 1.000 Mitarbeitende zuverlässig, gesetzeskonform und effizient durchgeführt wird und entwickelst unsere Payroll-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung! Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben Payroll & Entgeltabrechnung: Eigenständige Durchführung der monatlichen Entgeltabrechnung für definierte Gesellschaften innerhalb der Arsipa Gruppe mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt. Sicherstellung einer termingerechten, korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Entgeltabrechnung für die Arsipa Holding sowie unsere über 20 Tochtergesellschaften. Bearbeitung lohnsteuer-, sozialversicherungs- und abrechnungsrelevanter Fragestellungen. Erstellung von Bescheinigungen, Meldungen sowie weiteren payrollrelevanten Auswertungen und Unterlagen. Payroll Operations & Zusammenarbeit: Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende, Führungskräfte sowie unsere Kolleg:innen aus People Operations in allen payrollrelevanten Fragestellungen. Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Krankenkassen, Sozialversicherungsträgern, Behörden sowie weiteren externen Stellen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, sowie den Kolleg:innen innerhalb unseres Payroll- und People-Teams. Unterstützung bei gesellschaftsübergreifenden Payroll-Themen innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe. Prozesse, Digitalisierung & Harmonisierung: Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung unserer Payroll-Prozesse über die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe hinweg. Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungspotenzialen innerhalb bestehender Payroll-Abläufe. Mitwirkung an Digitalisierungsprojekten sowie der Weiterentwicklung unserer Payroll-Systemlandschaft mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt und Personio. Unterstützung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Payroll-Strukturen innerhalb einer stark wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe. Deine Startvoraussetzungen Das bringst Du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer-, Sozialversicherungs- und Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Payroll-Prozessen. Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit einer Weiterbildung im Bereich Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, Personalfachkaufleute oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation. Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein. Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und internen Fachbereichen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in der Harmonisierung, Standardisierung oder Digitalisierung von Payroll-Prozessen. Hilfreich ist ein Verständnis für Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder dynamisch wachsende Unternehmensstrukturen. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie unterschiedlichen internen und externen Stakeholdern. Unsere Benefits Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einer krisensicheren und nachhaltig wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, jeweils ein halber zusätzlicher freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie ein hybrides Setup mit einem Home-Office-Tag pro Woche. Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in unserem zentral gelegenen Office in 45659 Recklinghausen. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre. Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Payroll-Prozesse sowie die Möglichkeit, Digitalisierung und Harmonisierung nachhaltig voranzutreiben. Payroll-Expertise im Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, einem erfahrenen Payroll-Team und unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus People Operations. Starkes Wachstumsumfeld: Tätigkeit in einer schnell wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe - unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus. Unser Bewerbungsprozess Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung über unser Stellenportal. Nach der Prüfung Deines CVs wartet ein dreistufiger Bewerbungsprozess auf dich. Dieser startet mit einem kurzen Telefonat mit Allen, Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, gefolgt von einem Video-Call mit Laura, Lead Payroll. Anschließend besteht die Möglichkeit, Christine, VP People sowie das Payroll-Team besser kennenzulernen. Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise! Wir freuen uns auf Dich! With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager Fiscal & Legal (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology and poised to propel Apaleo into 180+ countries. Be a pivotal part of crafting a fiscal/legal framework that empowers Apaleo to swiftly become compliant in new territories!

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered.

title: (Senior) Finance Manager (all genders)
description: At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams. We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet! Your mission: As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO. This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function. Your responsibilities: Own our HGB-compliant accounting: run the month-end and year-end close and deliver accurate, timely financial statements with our external accountants. Run financial operations end-to-end: accounts receivable and payable, tax-compliant invoicing, payment runs, expense flows and cash management. Manage statutory reporting and tax topics (e.g. Jahresabschluss / annual financial statements, VAT) together with our external tax advisors. Prepare and manage the annual audit: audit files, documentation and communication with auditors. Support controlling and strategic finance topics: management reporting, analyses and spreadsheet-based models that inform business decisions. Be the driving force behind the introduction of innovative AI-based processes, building a state-of-the-art efficient and effective finance setup. Manage and develop our finance working student. Your profile: 3–5 years of experience in accounting and/or finance roles. Solid HGB accounting experience, including month-end and year-end close. Hands-on experience in financial operations (invoicing, payments, expense management, cash). Very diligent and reliable: high attention to detail, structured, and on top of many short- and long-term deadlines. You are highly autonomous and have a hands-on mentality: you are comfortable owning the full breath of the finance function. You take responsibility for getting things done and you are very good at collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience driving innovation and AI in Finance: You have designed, optimized and automated processes and are confident using AI tools. Fluent in German and English (written and spoken). Your benefits: Opportunity : Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact : Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers. Autonomy : Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom. Flexible work model : At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits for Germany-based employees : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realize!
