title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts. To do so, here's what you'll own: BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value. Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast. Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings. DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans. Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect. Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features. DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data. Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact. Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions. Requirements Must-have 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS : You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing. ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models : You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR. 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions : You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough. 🧮 Deep analytical rigour : You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity. 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational : You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes. 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers : You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience. 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks : You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you. 🤝 Cross-functional influence : You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions. 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount : You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management. Nice-to-have 🎓 Formal pricing training : You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you. 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience : You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams. 🌍 Open source or freemium background : You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust. Why join us? At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now - and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. * Country-specific details are provided in your contract. title: Werkstudent im Bereich Innovation, New Business & Startups (all people)
description: Worum es geht: Du steckst mitten im Studium und möchtest neben der Theorie Einblicke in Innovation, neue Geschäftsmodelle und aktuelle Trends gewinnen? Du hast Spaß daran, dich mit neuen Technologien, Start-ups und Entwicklungen zu beschäftigen und herauszufinden, was davon für die Versicherungswirtschaft relevant werden könnte? Du recherchierst und analysierst gern, denkst kreativ und hast Lust, deine eigenen Ideen und Perspektiven einzubringen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen, um zu schauen, wie du unser Team als Werkstudent:in Innovation, New Business & Startups (all people) mit 15 – 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst! Wir, die Versicherungsforen Leipzig, unterstützen Unternehmen der Versicherungswirtschaft bei ihren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsvorhaben. Wir erforschen und analysieren neue Trends, erarbeiten daraus konkrete Anforderungen für die Unternehmen und entwickeln gemeinsam Lösungsansätze. Neben Marktanalysen, Studien sowie Strategieberatung sind die Versicherungsforen Leipzig als Anbieter von Aus- und Weiterbildungsformaten wie Seminaren, Fachkonferenzen und Messekongressen bekannt. Das bewirkst du bei uns: Du wirkst im Tagesgeschäft und in Projekten rund um Innovation & New Business in der Versicherungswirtschaft mit. Du recherchierst und analysierst aktuelle Trends, Technologien, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Marktentwicklungen und bereitest relevante Impulse für unsere Projekte und Formate auf. Du bringst dich kreativ in die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Ideen und Formate ein – von der ersten Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung. Du arbeitest an unserem Trendradar mit, recherchierst und bewertest neue Entwicklungen, bereitest Inhalte auf, führst Plausibilitätschecks durch und erstellst begleitende Unterlagen. Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops, Veranstaltungen und weiteren Austauschformaten und wirkst bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen und Arbeitsmaterialien mit. Du bereitest Erkenntnisse, Trends und Impulse zielgruppengerecht auf und hilfst uns dabei, auch komplexe Themen verständlich und ansprechend für unterschiedliche Kommunikations- und Austauschformate zu vermitteln. Du wirkst aktiv in unserem New Players Network mit und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Start-up- und InsurTech-Szene. Dabei recherchierst du neue Unternehmen und ihre Geschäftsmodelle, identifizierst interessante New Player, unterstützt die Vernetzung in unserem Start-up-Netzwerk und wirkst bei unseren Pitch- und Austauschformaten mit. Darum passt du zu uns: Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor dir und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Du interessierst dich für Innovation, neue Technologien, Trends und Geschäftsmodelle und hast Lust, dich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen. Du recherchierst gern, kannst Informationen strukturiert und verständlich aufbereiten und gehst sicher mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen um. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig, bist neugierig, kreativ und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein. Du interessierst dich für generative KI und hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools gesammelt. Freue dich auf Folgendes: Bei uns kannst du deine Kenntnisse in innovativen Themen vertiefen, eigene Ideen einbringen und deine Fähigkeiten aktiv weiterentwickeln. Du bekommst Einblicke in verschiedene Themenbereiche und sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung. Dich erwarten eine lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigenständiges Arbeiten. Für deine Energie und Konzentration sorgen wir mit einer Kaffee-, Tee- und Wasserflat. Deine Arbeitszeiten und -orte kannst du flexibel an dein Studium anpassen. Unser modernes Büro liegt zentral in Leipzig und in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Universität. Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents, Gesundheitsangebote und weitere gemeinsame Aktionen sorgen für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag. Wie gehts jetzt weiter? Du fühlst dich angesprochen und möchtest gern mit uns durchstarten? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kleines Motivationsschreiben. Bei Fragen kannst du dich gerne direkt an unsere Recruiterin Jule wenden – telefonisch unter 0341 98988 123 oder per Mail an . Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! description: Job summary (Short promotional text) PNO Innovation UK is looking for an experienced Senior Innovation Consultant / Senior Grant Writer to lead complex Horizon Europe proposals and advise innovative organisations on their funding strategies. This is a genuinely senior role combining approximately 60% grant writing and 40% innovation consultancy. You will work independently with clients, technical experts and international consortium partners, transforming ambitious scientific and technological concepts into compelling, competitive proposals. Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below Your mission is to help innovative organisations secure European funding and turn promising ideas into impactful collaborative projects. You will guide clients from initial opportunity assessment and project concept development through to the preparation and submission of high-quality Horizon Europe proposals. As a trusted advisor, you will combine exceptional writing skills with strategic insight, technical curiosity and strong client leadership. Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets) Lead complex Horizon Europe proposals from initial strategy and concept development through to final submission. Write and review Excellence, Impact and Implementation sections, ensuring a clear, persuasive and evaluator-focused narrative. Develop project structures, work packages, deliverables, milestones, budgets and implementation plans. Coordinate international consortia, technical contributors and other stakeholders throughout the proposal process. Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets) Advise clients on funding opportunities, programme positioning, call requirements and long-term funding strategies. Translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, compelling and commercially relevant applications. Manage senior client relationships, challenge assumptions and provide confident strategic recommendations. Support business development while mentoring colleagues and reviewing and improving the quality of their work. Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets) At least eight years of relevant professional experience in grant writing, innovation consultancy, European funding or a closely related field. Extensive, hands-on experience with Horizon Europe and/or Horizon 2020 proposals. A strong track record of independently leading competitive proposals from concept to submission. Genuine consulting experience, including ownership of client relationships and complex assignments. Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets) Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly. Strong scientific, technical or innovation literacy and the curiosity to understand unfamiliar technologies quickly. Ability to work credibly across sectors such as life sciences, health, agrifood, bio-based industries, energy, environment and industrial innovation. A highly autonomous, commercially aware and collaborative approach, together with the right to work in the UK. Why us? title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to <strong>be curious, have courage, and commit fully</strong>.</p> <p>Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape how technology empowers neurodivergent individuals and people with physical, sensory and other disabilities.</p> <p>You'll work across Everway's portfolio of special education and assistive technology solutions for school and workplace environments, collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Content and other cross-functional partners.</p> <p>A key focus of this role will be our IEP product portfolio, including Polaris, Embrace Education and Spedtrack. You'll work across interconnected products and experiences, helping create coherent, accessible and scalable solutions that support the needs of educators, administrators and students.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to think beyond individual features and products. You'll help shape shared experiences and interaction patterns across the portfolio, balancing consistency with the unique context and needs of individual products and users.</p> <p>You'll lead end-to-end design work, from understanding complex problems and synthesising research through ideation, prototyping, validation and delivery. You'll contribute to product strategy, design quality and our design system, while exploring practical applications of AI and emerging technologies.</p> <p>You'll also work closely with other designers, providing senior design partnership, sharing knowledge and helping raise design quality across the portfolio.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to have a significant influence on the future of Everway's IEP experiences and help create accessible, coherent and high-quality products that make a meaningful difference to the people who use them.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h4><strong>Main responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Content and Marketing to deliver product experiences that meet user and business needs.</li> <li>Own end-to-end design work within your scope, contributing design expertise to product decisions from early discovery through delivery and iteration.</li> <li>Help frame problems, identify opportunities and contribute design insight to product strategy and planning.</li> <li>Design across interconnected products, workflows and user journeys to create scalable and coherent experiences.</li> <li>Translate user insights, product analytics and business objectives into intuitive, accessible and scalable design solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with Engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and effectively implemented.</li> <li>Contribute to and evolve Everway's design system, supporting consistency, scalability and accessibility across products.</li> <li>Explore and apply AI where it creates meaningful value, improving design workflows, accelerating prototyping and supporting new product experiences, while considering usability, accessibility, trust, transparency and user control.</li> <li>Create and present design concepts, prototypes and solutions with clear rationale linked to user, product and business objectives.</li> <li>Advocate for inclusive design and ensure work meets or exceeds relevant accessibility standards.</li> <li>Partner with researchers to integrate user insights into iterative design and validation cycles.</li> <li>Balance qualitative user insights with quantitative product analytics to inform design decisions and measure the success of shipped experiences.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops, design reviews and co-creation sessions with peers and stakeholders.</li> <li>Share knowledge and contribute to design practice, learning and innovation across the UX and Product organisation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Essential criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Significant product design experience, including 3+ years operating at Senior Product Designer level, with a strong portfolio demonstrating how design decisions contributed to measurable user, product or business outcomes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity, frame complex problems and influence product direction.</li> <li>Experience applying inclusive and universal design principles, reducing cognitive load, and designing to recognised accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2</li> <li>Experience designing across interconnected products, complex workflows or end-to-end user journeys while considering the wider product ecosystem.</li> <li>Hands-on experience contributing to and evolving design systems.</li> <li>Strong prototyping and interaction design skills, with the ability to use prototypes to explore, test and communicate ideas.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern design tools such as Figma.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-enhanced design workflows and an understanding of emerging human-AI interaction patterns, including trust, transparency, uncertainty and user control.</li> <li>Ability to communicate and influence design decisions clearly across a range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with Product Management and Engineering, balancing user needs, business goals and technical constraints.</li> <li>Understanding of modern product development approaches such as Agile, Lean UX, continuous discovery and iterative delivery, with experience facilitating collaborative design activities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience designing across Web, iOS and Android in a complex SaaS environment.</li> <li>Experience designing products for education, accessibility, assistive technology or other complex user needs.</li> <li>Experience designing or shipping AI-enabled product experiences.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or design-to-development workflows.</li> <li>Experience working with product analytics and experimentation to evaluate product outcomes.</li> <li>Familiarity with designing for enterprise, education or multi-user environments with complex permissions, roles or workflows.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit your application by <strong>Friday 18th September 2026.</strong></p> <p>Please note: applications may close early due to high demand, so early submission is encouraged.</p> <p>#everway</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Join our team and enjoy a competitive salary with bonus opportunities, flexible work schedules, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. We offer flexible time off plans, career growth through development programs, and a collaborative, innovative culture where your ideas matter.&nbsp; Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be part of a company that invests in your success!</p> <p>We are committed to providing a Drug-Free Workplace for all employees.</p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>You can view our Recruitment and Selection Policy <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yDxHyVbhh8MK9NnCYdnEAfVSO4rhPCovVbKK8ecxT4U/edit?usp=sharing">here.</a></p> <p>Please click the link for our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uAKvHVSRsqZ83CGhM3_3Dc6RPsXwlTdmwdUH7msHkVM/edit?usp=sharing">Privacy Notice</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex helps ambitious businesses operate globally by providing the financial infrastructure they need to manage payments, money movement and related financial operations. The Account Management team works strategically to maximise the enterprise customer-Airwallex partnership by building trust, identifying and driving new revenue streams, and ensuring operational success.. You will work alongside , Leadership, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations,Legal, GTM Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance and Revenue Strategy & Operations. The team operates with a high level of ownership and collaboration, managing complex customer needs and contributing directly to enterprise growth. What you’ll do As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, , escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in London, UK. Responsibilities: Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite. Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities. Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities. Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives. Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage. Preferred qualifications: Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products. Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders. A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline. Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. You will contribute across frontend and backend systems, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. You will build and evolve APIs and microservices, and help integrate modern AI capabilities into production experiences where they add clear user value. The role requires strong technical judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to move from concept through delivery in a fast-paced environment.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We use AI agents and smart tooling across brainstorming, planning, analysis, and implementation. People set the direction, exercise judgment, and own the outcomes.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agentic frameworks — and can describe projects where you shipped real customer-facing work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, validate its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. title: Senior Accountant - IFRS
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Accountant, you will: Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed. Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process. Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership. Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate. Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios. Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments. Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors. A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency. The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment. Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards. Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity. Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting. The location This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience. Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders. Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

What you'll be doing

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

  • Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

  • Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

  • Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

  • Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

  • Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

  • Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

  • Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

  • Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

  • Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

  • Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

  • Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

  • A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

  • Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

  • A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>Anduril is seeking a Senior Supply Planner to join our team in Sydney, Australia. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: Who are we? Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business. The Team Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely. About the Role: This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need. What you will do: Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams. Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products. Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping. Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations. Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis. Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient. Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits. Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences. Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper. Role Requirements: Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure. Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements. AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices. CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair). Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC. Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices. Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes. Nice-to-have: Demonstrated experience deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers; a personal interest in sports, exchanges, or trading; certifications such as DSOP, CKS, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, or an AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty; a track record of security automation at scale in Agile/Scrum environments; direct experience with regulators/examiners on technology and system safeguards; and familiarity with event contracts, prediction markets, or similar novel futures products under CFTC. Our Values Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment: Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence. Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement. Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make. Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard. Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us. Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment. Perks & Benefits We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win. Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth, and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally. These include: Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success. Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in. Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life's most important moments. Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food. Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active. Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training. Holiday: 25 days paid leave plus bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days. Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle. Global Working: Work from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days a year. Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events, because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand. What happens next CV application review: We will review it as quickly as possible. Let's chat: A quick chat with our team about your experience and the role. Competency Interview: Virtual with the Hiring Manager. In-Office Interview: Meet the wider team. Diversity & Inclusion We're an equal opportunities employer and celebrate diversity in all its forms. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know; we're happy to accommodate your needs. Smarkets is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equality, inclusion, and a welcoming environment for all. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD)
description: Tired of retail pharmacy? Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes. No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care. Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking That's what we're building at Montu. You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right. As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD), you will be responsible for carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions before they are supplied to patients. You will act as an independent safeguard within the dispensing process, ensuring that medicines are assembled exactly as prescribed and in line with legal, operational and patient safety standards. Getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will be trusted to exercise professional judgement, identify risks before they become incidents, and have the confidence to stop the process whenever something does not look right. What will you be doing? Carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed medicines, confirming that the product supplied matches the prescription and accompanying documentation. Verifying the right patient, right medicine, right strength, right formulation, right quantity and right directions , ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate. Checking that medicines have been assembled in accordance with legal requirements, SOPs and company processes. Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors immediately, supporting a culture of openness and continuous improvement. Maintaining clear, accurate and auditable records of all checks completed. Exercising professional judgement and recognising when concerns fall outside your scope of practice, referring to the Responsible Pharmacist where appropriate. Supporting the safe handling and checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and high-risk medications , in accordance with relevant legislation and internal procedures. Ensuring appropriate expiry date checks, batch number verification (where applicable), and packaging integrity checks are completed before supply. Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries efficiently while maintaining independence during the final checking process. Contributing to quality assurance initiatives, investigations and process improvements aimed at reducing dispensing errors and improving patient safety. Supporting and mentoring colleagues, helping to embed a culture of accountability, quality and attention to detail. Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking. What do you need? An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice. Significant experience working within a pharmacy environment with a proven track record of conducting final accuracy checks. A detailed understanding of the dispensing process and the critical control points that prevent medication errors. Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles. The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately. Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace. Confidence to challenge discrepancies and halt the supply process when patient safety could be compromised. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive mindset, taking ownership of issues and following them through to resolution. A genuine commitment to patient outcomes — understanding that every prescription represents a person relying on you to get it right. raw.title: Courses and Memberships Sales Associate
raw.description:
The Company

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of certifications, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.

We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

 
 

About the Role

We’re hiring Sales Associates to join our Education & Membership Sales team, people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.

Your primary focus will be selling our professionals certifications, memberships, and online learning solutions in global markets. You will manage the end-to-end cycle while getting comfortable with engaging senior decision-makers at leading tech companies. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.

This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.

 
 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Sales Core: Focused on prospecting, leads qualification, pipeline management, and deal closing. Be able to hold your ground with senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.

  • Engaging Decision-Makers: Speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right core certifications and different tiered memberships.

  • Owning Deals End-to-End: Own the pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.

  • Product Mastery: Develop strong knowledge of our core certifications, different tiered memberships, and broader education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

  • Collaboration & Feedback: Work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.

 
 

This Role Is For You If

  • Seeking a role to work hard and build a strong career in professional sales.

  • Having a background or a strong interest in education sales, training products, or learning solutions.

  • Comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new and navigating unfamiliar software or sales scripts.

  • Open to actively seeking out feedback and applying it quickly to daily workflow.

  • Taking complete ownership for outcomes, not just daily effort or hours put in.

  • Resilient, organised, and fully able to manage high pace and volume pressure.

  • Communicating clearly with customers and with teammates alike.

  • Enjoying working as part of a high-energy team where success is shared.

 
 

Base Salary: £26,500 - £28,000 (range depending on experience)
Year 1 OTE: Estimated £35,000 (uncapped)
Year 2 OTE: Estimated £55,000 (uncapped)

Location: this role can be hybrid in our London office or fully remote within the UK (Not abroad).

____________________________

 
 

Benefits

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday.

  • Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best.

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in.

  • WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget.

  • A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office.

Health & wellbeing

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa.

  • Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary.

  • On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill.

  • Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes.

  • Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes.

  • Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts.

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you.

Learning & development

  • A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year).

  • Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

  • Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications.

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.

Encouraging diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives, applications are welcomed regardless of whether every listed requirement is fully met.
