title: Software Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Software Architect</strong></p> <p>At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <p><strong>Why this role matters now</strong></p> <p>This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:</p> <ul> <li>Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.</li> <li>Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.</li> <li>Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.</li> <li>Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.</li> <li>Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.</li> <li>Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.</p> <p><strong>About the interview process</strong></p> <p>The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11267<br><strong>Reporting into:&nbsp;</strong>Manager<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-teams="true">#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior GTM System Builder
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.</p> <p>You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would do</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion</li> <li>Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up</li> <li>Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start</li> <li>Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment</li> <li>Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions</li> <li>Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would bring</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)</li> <li>Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets</li> <li>Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes</li> <li>Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems</li> <li>Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running</li> <li>Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations</li> <li>Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada</li> </ul><div class="title">Ireland</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€61.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€100.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><h3>POSITION OVERVIEW</h3> <p>Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift.</p> <p>The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.</p> <p>Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.</p> <h3>RESPONSIBILITIES</h3> <h3>Product marketing strategy</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market research and customer insights</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Team and function leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

📐 About the role

At WRITER, our mission to expand human capacity with superintelligence relies on a foundational truth: our platform must be available, performant, and reliable, 24/7. As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering.

Technical

  • Breadth across disciplines. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. This is not a thrash-every-week role — most of the time you're heads-down on one substantial initiative (the on-call posture, the release pipeline, the multi-region Terraform layout, the internal platform surface). Cross-layer fluency is what lets you pick the right next initiative; it isn't a weekly context-switch.

Challenge the status quo and remove toil before adding features — automate operational tasks and infrastructure management with Python or Go, reject tools that don't fit the problem, and treat manual on-call work as a defect to be designed out, not a status quo to be staffed up.

raw.title: Operational Excellence & Procedures Lead
raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

The Operational Excellence & Procedures Lead is responsible for driving continuous improvement across Operations, ensuring that operational processes, procedures, knowledge management and supporting technologies evolve in line with the Bank's growth strategy.

Sitting within the Operations – Financial Crime and Customer Experience function, this role acts as the bridge between Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Change, ensuring operational processes remain efficient, scalable, customer focused and well governed.

The role goes beyond traditional business procedure management by including the adoption of AI-enabled solutions across Operations. The successful candidate will identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve colleague productivity, enhance knowledge management and embed intelligent workflows that support better customer and business outcomes, while ensuring that the process for keeping procedures updated remains efficient and scalable.

This is a key role in shaping the future operating model of Operations, driving operational excellence, process optimisation and AI adoption to ensure Allica remains at the forefront of modern banking operations, with well mitigated operational risk.

Operational Excellence

  • Own and continuously evolve the way Operations works.

  • Lead process/procedure reviews across all operational functions, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate activities.

  • Facilitate workshops to map, review and optimise end-to-end customer journeys and operational processes.

  • Partner with operational teams to identify pain points, risks and inefficiencies, delivering practical and measurable solutions.

  • Ensure operational processes remain scalable and aligned to the Bank's strategic objectives.

  • Track and report on process performance metrics and continuous improvement outcomes.

  • Support the successful operational embedding of new products, services, regulatory changes and technology enhancements.

Process & Procedure Governance

  • Maintain oversight of operational process documentation and procedure standards across Operations.

  • Support Procedure Owners in maintaining accurate, compliant and version-controlled procedures.

  • Own reviews and updates for central operations procedures, ensuring any updates are signed off by key business stakeholders and communicated to end users.

  • Routinely review and update FAQs, seeking appropriate stakeholder signoff and publishing on the website.

  • Ensure operational procedures remain aligned to Bank Policies, Risk Frameworks and regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct impact assessments for product, technology and regulatory changes to identify documentation updates and operational implications.

  • Attend Product, Change and Governance forums to ensure operational readiness considerations are captured.

  • Facilitate procedure review activities and monitor closure of agreed actions.

  • Promote best practice standards for process mapping, documentation and operational governance.

AI Enablement & Innovation

  • Lead the adoption of AI capabilities across Procedures and Training to improve productivity, quality, colleague experience and customer outcomes.

  • Design, develop and continuously improve AI-enabled workflows using approved technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and other emerging AI tools.

  • Measure, track and report on tangible benefits realised through AI adoption and automation initiatives.

  • Champion a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across operational teams.

Change Delivery & Business Readiness

  • Support the successful delivery of operational change initiatives within the Operations department.

  • Lead requirements gathering and discovery workshops with business stakeholders.

  • Coordinate operational readiness assessments and implementation planning.

  • Develop robust procedures and supporting materials to support change adoption.

  • Maintain and continuously develop Management Information (MI) reporting across all areas of Operations, ensuring accurate, timely and meaningful reporting to support performance management, operational oversight and informed decision-making.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Significant experience within Operational Excellence, Business Process Improvement, Procedure Management and Stakeholder Management.

  • Strong process mapping and end-to-end process design capability.

  • 2+ years of line management experience.

  • Excellent understanding of operational governance, risk management and control environments.

  • Experience identifying and implementing operational efficiencies through automation or digital solutions.

  • Strong understanding of applicable AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and business engagement experience.

  • Exceptional written communication, documentation and presentation skills.

  • Strong analytical capability with experience using data to support decision making.

  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.

Desirable

  • Experience designing AI prompts, knowledge assistants or AI-enabled workflows.

  • Understanding of Operational Resilience, Consumer Duty and FCA regulatory requirements.

  • Experience working within a fast-growing bank, fintech or regulated financial services environment.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

Excellent written and verbal communication - able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.


As Senior CRM Project Manager for Personalized Promotions & Wallet reporting to the CRM Group Director, you will drive Veepee's promotional strategy across all six European markets (France, Benelux, Germany, Spain, Italy & Switzerland) and business scopes (Flash Sales, Brandsplace, Clearance, Media, Le Club).

 

You own two interconnected mandates :

 

1/ Maximise the ROI of promotional marketing budget — covering all voucher and incentive mechanics across the full customer lifecycle, whether funded by Veepee or by brand partners.

 

2/ Lead the CRM workstream of the Wallet & Promotional Products project — Veepee's flagship 2026–2028 initiative to transform the “Mes Promos” space into a personalized, gamified promotional wallet.

 

You operate at the intersection of CRM strategy, product development and data. You influence without direct authority, acting as the bridge between the CRM team and other main stakeholders (Front/Growth, sourcing, finance teams).

You are accountable for defining your OKRs, owning your roadmap and delivering measurable impact on promotional performance.

Promotional Budget Strategy & ROI Optimisation

  • Lead the execution with contribution of tech, data and operational teams
  • Define the right promotional mechanics for the right moment: welcome offers, cashback, brand-funded vouchers, targeted incentives, win-back promos.

    •

      • Serve as the single point of contact for promotional topics within the CRM team and toward external stakeholders (Finance, Brand Partnerships, Product, Tech).

You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.</p> <p>AI is not optional here. while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19,&nbsp;Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.</li> <li>Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt</li> <li>Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents</li> <li>Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line</li> <li>Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time</li> <li>Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Qualifications:<br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19</li> <li>A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket</li> <li>Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial customer problems</li> <li><strong>Fluent, persuasive communicator</strong> – You write, present, and negotiate confidently in English while actively listening, distilling insights, persuading stakeholders, and selling product value</li> <li><strong>Proactive problem-solver</strong> – You spot issues, rally the right people, and deliver solutions, no waiting for task lists</li> </ul> <p><em>BONUS POINTS</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with managing products that rely on external or third-party data sources, comfortable analyzing ROI, negotiating data costs, and adapting quickly to changes in API availability or pricing</li> <li>Experience with analytics, data visualization, or insight-generation tools</li> <li>Background in social media, audience research, or digital strategy</li> <li>Passion for empowering organizations to make smarter, faster, data-driven decisions</li> </ul> <h3>What We Offer&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>International and fast-paced environment</li> Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our E uropean Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software. By acting as trusted technical advisors , you and your team will utilize deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition—showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges. This includes both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. Additionally, you will serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team . Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions — either as a practitioner running simulations, or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Not just use AI, Be part of a team that is actively redefining how the next-generation silicon and hardware are architected. Work at the absolute convergence of state of the art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment. À propos de Vinci Nous développons une technologie d’IA basée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme logicielle aide les concepteurs hardware et les ingénieur·es en simulation physique à explorer, analyser et optimiser des systèmes complexes, en s’appuyant sur des technologies d’IA de pointe pour fournir une intelligence physique ultra-rapide et précise, intégrée aux réalités des processus de conception en ingénierie. Notre premier produit comble le fossé entre la précision et le déterminisme des simulations traditionnelles et la rapidité et la capacité de mise à l’échelle de l’IA. Il redéfinit la manière dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes. Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment , vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci auprès des principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, dédiée à l’accompagnement de clients potentiels et à la démonstration de la valeur transformative de notre logiciel. En tant que conseiller·ère technique de confiance, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous porterez la proposition de valeur de Vinci en démontrant comment notre plateforme permet d’améliorer de manière systémique les performances thermiques, la fiabilité des produits et la vitesse de mise sur le marché. Grâce à de solides fondamentaux en physique thermique et en stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, de dynamiques des écoulements de fluides et de problématiques de dissipation thermique. Cela inclut aussi bien les comportements thermiques en régime permanent que transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des facteurs critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité du refroidissement afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique de pointe pour les matériels de nouvelle génération. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie des clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et d’expliquer clairement les capacités de Vinci à résoudre des problèmes concrets. Vous serez également un relais essentiel entre les clients et nos équipes Produit et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables permettant d’orienter la feuille de route produit et d’alimenter l’amélioration continue. Il s’agit d’un poste basé en France et en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie, aux États-Unis. Le poste implique des déplacements modérés, principalement en Europe continentale. Des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pourront également être nécessaires pour des échanges et des collaborations avec l’équipe américaine. Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe. Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels. Accompagner les équipes d’ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d’évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l’exécution de cas de test complexes et l’interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci. Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Expertise technique : Maîtrise experte de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d’expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — soit en tant que praticien·ne réalisant des simulations, soit en tant que Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des clients issus de l’ingénierie. Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des workflows ou analyser des données issues de simulations. Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l’exécution au sein d’équipes d’ingénierie. Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des interlocuteurs techniques de haut niveau que pour des dirigeants orientés business. Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants) Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance des simulations mécaniques structurelles (FEA/contraintes) et/ou des workflows de Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI). Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d’Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l’électronique. Expérience Go-to-Market : Expérience préalable dans des environnements de pré-vente technique, d’application engineering (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique. Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des workflows de nouvelle génération basés sur la physique ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l’IA. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ne vous contentez pas d’utiliser l’IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus. Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d’IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux. Collaborez avec des ingénieur·es et chercheur·ses de renommée mondiale dans un environnement startup dynamique et en pleine évolution. raw.description:
Solutions Engineer

 

About Neural Concept

Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster. They are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.

Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity, turning months of simulation into days and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.

We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.

 

About the Role

As a Solutions Engineer, you sit at the intersection of engineering credibility and strategic influence. You are the person in the room who can connect a VP's business challenge to a concrete, well-scoped AI solution, and who knows Neural Concept's platform and roadmap well enough to make that connection land with confidence.

This is not a purely technical role, and it is not a pure sales role. You are a trusted advisor: someone who earns credibility through engineering background and product depth, and who builds long-term account relationships by consistently framing the right problems and the right solutions at the right moment. You drive the full pre-sales motion, from discovery to demo to signed Statement of Work, and you remain the account's technical compass through the client lifecycle, identifying and shaping expansion opportunities.

 

What you will do

  • Position NC as a long-term strategic partner and trusted engineering advisor across engineering teams, managers, and VPs

  • Lead structured discovery sessions to identify where NC creates the most impact, framing use cases that are technically feasible and commercially grounded

  • Define the AI strategy and technical roadmap for each account, translating NC's capabilities and product direction into a multi-horizon vision

  • Create and deliver compelling, client-tailored demos and presentations grounded in the client's engineering workflows, technically credible and aligned with the vision

  • Create and co-own the Statement of Work, with deep understanding of the technical building blocks and how these transform the client's existing workflows

  • Prepare and run Steering Committees, connecting engineering challenges to strategic outcomes

  • Drive user adoption and engagement across technical users, managers, and designers, ensuring NC is embedded in daily workflows and engineering champions emerge

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities from account knowledge and commercial signals, and shape them into well-scoped proposals

  • Collaborate with the Sales team to advance and close deals, with the Forward Deployed Engineering team to ensure smooth pre-sales to delivery transitions, and surface client insights to Product and R&D to inform roadmap priorities

 

Who you are

  • You hold an engineering degree (mechanical, aerospace, automotive, industrial, or similar) and have a solid understanding of CAD and CAE workflows, including where bottlenecks lie and what it takes to transform those workflows with AI

  • You are naturally curious and people-driven. You earn trust through genuine interest in client challenges and make engineers and executives feel understood

  • You are proactive and commercially driven. You move accounts forward without being asked, spot opportunities early, and bring structure to ambiguous situations

  • You are a confident challenger. You ask uncomfortable questions, reframe assumptions, and guide clients toward better outcomes even when it requires pushing back

  • You are an outstanding communicator: you own executive conversations, drive narrative with clarity, and connect engineering problems to strategic outcomes

  • You understand AI and machine learning applied to engineering at a conceptual level, and are comfortable creating demos and prototypes using AI-assisted tools with working knowledge of Python and modern development practices

  • You have experience in a client-facing role: pre-sales, solutions consulting, technical account management, or engineering consulting

  • Professional fluency in French and English

     

What Will Set You Apart

Candidates who bring the following will be able to take on a wider scope and go deeper with the most technically complex accounts:

  • You have deep, hands-on simulation experience: full pipelines from CAD to post-processing, solver experience, and workflow automation

  • You are a strong programmer: you write clean Python, build data pipelines, and are comfortable in ML/DL frameworks including model training, evaluation, and deployment

  • You can go deep in technical discovery: dive into customer toolchains, data environments, and simulation setups to assess feasibility at the level a simulation engineer would respect

  • You can build end-to-end engineering workflow demos from scratch, rapidly prototyping the full arc from design generation and simulation to data pipelines, model training, and application deployment using agentic development tools

 

Nice-to-Have

  • Strategic or technical consulting background, executing digital transformations

  • Previous experience working in engineering software companies or using engineering software tools (e.g., Ansys, Altair, Siemens, Dassault Systèmes, or Autodesk)

  • Background in ML/DL research or development in an engineering context

  • Experience automating CAE workflows (scripting, batch processing, surrogate model pipelines)

 

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Sustainability and Public Affairs Intern (Paris )
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: Join Back Market's Impact team for a unique dual-mission internship where you'll contribute to both our Sustainability and Public Affairs initiatives. You'll support our B Corp recertification, develop responsible business practices with suppliers/sellers, and help shape the regulatory framework for the circular economy. This role offers a comprehensive view of how companies can drive systemic change through both internal sustainability practices and external policy advocacy. Develop responsible business conduct practices by creating sustainability databases, drafting questionnaires, and preparing roll-out plans Drive internal engagement through employee initiatives, sustainability events, communication materials, and philanthropy reporting Contribute to tech impact monitoring and ESG reporting Public Affairs (50%) Conduct legal analysis of bill drafts, parliamentary discussions, and votes related to circular economy at French, UK and EU levels Monitor policy-making processes at national and EU levels Develop stakeholders mapping and contribute to position paper building Participate in external meetings with policymakers, industry associations, and stakeholders Track regulatory developments impacting refurbished electronics and circular economy YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You're currently pursuing a Master's degree in Sustainability, Public Policy, Public Affairs, Environmental Studies, Law, Political Science, or related field You’re capable of reading and understanding the law and understand policy making processes in France and Europe You have strong analytical and research capabilities with excellent organizational skills You're fluent in English and French (written and spoken) You're proficient in Excel/Google Sheets for database management and tracking You can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable certified B Corp company (93.2). raw.title: Senior Product Manager - BackShip
raw.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About the team

The Shipping Group owns everything that moves at Back Market – from the moment a seller configures their listings to the moment a customer's order is delivered. We're organized across two squads and one strategic program:

  • Shipping Core squad – BackShip (managed labels, carrier network, billing, warranty), transit time infrastructure, carrier optimization, and collection point UX

  • Delivery Experience (DXP) squad – Customer-facing delivery promise (PDP, Cart, Checkout), post-dispatch tracking, and delivery notifications

  • BFF program – Back Market's logistic infrastructure, which integrates our fulfillment, trade-in, and B2B operations.

Shipping Core and DXP are deeply interdependent: Shipping Core builds the rails, DXP surfaces them to customers. Our products directly impact €3.5B+ in annual GMV and every single order placed on the platform.

About the scope

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own BackShip – Back Market's managed shipping solution for sellers, and one of the highest-leverage infrastructure bets in the company.

BackShip is how Back Market takes control of the physical flow of goods: instead of relying on sellers to choose their own carriers, Back Market negotiates the rates, generates the labels, and manages the carrier relationship end-to-end. It's both a seller-facing product and the core infrastructure layer that will power Back Market's own fulfillment operations (BFF) at scale.

Currently, BackShip sees a minority of our sellers using the service. We aim to significantly grow this adoption rate in the coming years, which is expected to generate substantial additional revenue.

You'll own six product domains:

  • Label Generation — Generate shipment labels for every order flow via our integrations with Teliae and Intersoft; distribute labels to sellers, customers, and agents; manage Tradelines configuration

  • Delivery Services — Pickup requests, Carrier-side collection point shipping method, QR code returns (e.g. UPS US), and future delivery modes as we expand the carrier network

  • BackShip Billing — Receive and process carrier invoices; bill logistics costs back to sellers; own logistic cost data feeding CCBM and Backbox

  • BackShip Warranty — For every shipment, decide whether BM applies carrier insurance or BM's own warranty; maintain warranty configuration across carriers and markets

  • Carrier Optimization — Smart routing (greenfield initiative — not yet existing); this is yours to define and build

  • BackShip Support — Own the seller support experience for BackShip-related issues, in coordination with Seller Success

About the mission

Business Impact

  • Own business outcomes with full accountability for BackShip attachment rate, carrier operational performance, and billing accuracy

  • Increase BackShip attachment rate by understanding why sellers adopt, why they churn, and what it takes to make BackShip the obvious default

  • Develop and communicate product priorities by synthesizing insights from sellers, carrier partners, logistics market trends, and internal data

Product Leadership

  • Lead your squad – own the roadmap and execution, make decisions with your engineering team, and foster autonomy while maintaining strategic alignment

  • Contribute to Shipping Group strategy – define your team’s tactic, lead cross-squad initiatives, and influence company-level logistics OKRs

  • Be the primary BackShip voice in the BFF program – ensuring label generation, carrier integrations, and pickup orchestration

Product Development

  • Lead end-to-end lifecycle of complex features from conception to launch – including Carrier Optimization (smart routing), BackShip Billing dashboard, collection point shipping method expansion, and BFF outbound integration

  • Prioritize ruthlessly, balancing seller adoption, carrier reliability, billing accuracy, and BFF readiness — and know when operational excellence is the product

Collaboration

  • Work closely with your Engineering Manager and engineering team to deliver with quick time-to-market and optimal resources

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders – Seller Success (onboarding, adoption), Finance (carrier invoices, CCBM data), Delivery Experience (collection point UX, promise accuracy), and the BFF program team

  • Work directly with external carrier partners (Colissimo, DHL, UPS, Chronopost, Royal Mail, and others) – you are the product owner of those relationships on the integration side

User Experience

  • Constantly evaluate seller satisfaction with BackShip – understand the friction points that prevent adoption and the operational pain points that cause churn

  • Stay ahead of logistics and carrier trends – know what competitors, 3PLs, and carrier networks are doing, and bring best practices into our product

  • Master your problem space – become the go-to expert on seller shipping operations; talk regularly with sellers, monitor carrier performance data, and own the feedback loop between the field and the roadmap.

About the role

  • 5+ years in Product Management with 2+ years in logistics, carrier operations, or marketplace infrastructure – You understand how carrier networks work, how integrations are built, and what makes a managed shipping product actually get adopted by merchants

  • Track record of shipping complex operational products with business impact – You've owned adoption or attachment metrics, delivered measurable revenue outcomes, and navigated the complexity of external partner dependencies (carriers, 3PLs, integrators)

  • Experience growing B2B product adoption – You know how to move an attachment rate, not just ship features; you've worked on onboarding funnels, commercial positioning, and seller activation loops

  • Carrier and logistics ecosystem knowledge – You understand label generation, carrier API integrations, pickup orchestration, transit time mechanics, warranty and insurance models, and how SLAs are structured with logistics partners Billing and operational data fluency – You're comfortable owning a billing product; you understand invoice processing, cost allocation, and how logistics cost data feeds financial reporting (P&L, CCBM)

  • Strong data-driven mindset – You use carrier performance metrics, adoption funnels, A/B testing, and seller research to drive decisions; bonus points for SQL/data analysis skills

  • Strategic thinker with execution excellence – You can define a 3-year vision for smart routing while also unblocking a label generation bug on a Friday afternoon; you balance long-term infrastructure bets with short-term operational reliability

  • Leading without authority and tribe-level influence – You align carrier partners, finance, seller success, and engineering independently; you are trusted beyond your squad and represent BackShip credibly in cross-functional programs like BFF

  • Excellent communicator and collaborator – You can translate carrier integration complexity into clear seller value propositions, navigate commercial conversations with logistics partners, and make billing data legible to finance stakeholders

  • Passionate about sustainability and seller empowerment – Back Market's mission resonates with your personal values; you understand that scaling BackShip is not just a revenue play — it's how we make sustainable commerce operationally viable at scale


About the recruitment process

  • Job Presentation: discussion with Marie ( Expert Talent Acquisition ), 45 min

  • Product Case: discussion with Etienne (Staff Product Manager - Hiring Manager) and Adrien (Head of Product) or Florent (Staff Product Manager) , 60 min

  • Stakeholders: interview with Rémi (Head of Logistics) or Adèle (Senior Lead Logistics Manager) and Andreea (Engineering Manager II) or Sneha (Head of Engineering), 45 min

  • Meet your manager , 30 min

  • Back Market Value: interview with Amandine (Chief Product Officer) and one ExCo&Co member, 45 min

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Mission Statement

The Team Leader, Production serves as the primary architect of operational output and staffing excellence. By merging the analytical rigor of capacity planning with direct floor management, this role ensures the seamless execution of verification tasks across multiple sites. The Production Team Leader is responsible for the optimization of resource allocation to meet global SLAs while maintaining data integrity and cost-efficiency.

 
 

1. Management of Operators & Performance

  • Direct Leadership: Build and mentor a high-performance team of operators.

  • Culture & Alignment: Foster a unified "One Team" culture between internal staff and BPO partners, ensuring that productivity and quality standards remain consistent across all locations.

  • Performance Frameworks: Design and oversee individual performance monitoring frameworks to establish a fair, transparent, and objective system for measuring productivity and operational impact.

2. Staffing & Capacity Planning

  • Capacity Planning: Develop and maintain sophisticated capacity planning models. Ensure these models are continuously updated to reflect new product launches and evolving methodologies, providing accurate staffing forecasts.

  • Demand Management: Collaborate with Customer Success teams to forecast merchant activity and adjust staffing levels dynamically, ensuring strategic and effective resource utilization.

3. Multi-Site Oversight & BPO Synchronization

  • Multi-Site Governance: Directly manage and synchronize production across multiple sites, ensuring contractual SLA adherence and cost-efficiency through rigorous performance reviews.

  • Operational Blueprint: Maintain master documentation for all production activities, including data access protocols, staffing workflows, and incident management plans.

4. Business Continuity & Crisis Readiness

  • Business Continuity Plan: Organize and maintain Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to ensure the Operations department can respond immediately to major disruptions across internal and BPO sites.

  • Incident Frameworks: Maintain the "Gold Standard" for incident response, ensuring documented and efficient on-call rotations and escalation paths. Oversee the drafting of all post-mortem incident reports.

  • Operational Policy: Regularly evaluate and update the operational policy regarding merchant prioritization to align with Account Management objectives and maintain adequate operational buffers.

  • Post-Mortem Integration: Ensure that findings from incident post-mortems are systematically translated into documentation updates or training modules, driving continuous improvement.

5. Infrastructure & Workflow Optimization

  • Hypervision Dashboarding: Maintain real-time visibility into operational health by managing live monitoring dashboards and advanced capacity planning tools.

  • Automation Stewardship: Identify manual bottlenecks on the production floor and implement automated solutions or workflow optimizations to streamline verification processes.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise.   • Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Rouen et alentours.
